verification.resource_impact: Full self-test top includes ROM/window/checker/UART; +2 BSRAM vs v69; not per-IP counts or hybrid-top resource proof

modules.name: img_filter_bilateral3x3
limitations: External 3x3 windows; command response acknowledges sigma configuration, not a frame
True spatial/range exponential weights, LUT step 1/16, unsigned Q8.8 sigma; 9 serial accumulations

modules.name: img_filter_guided
limitations: 8-bit independent aligned source and guide, atomically paired input; two box passes with covariance
Default max frame 64x64 and radius3; epsilon Q8 rounded upward to squared guide units; direct divider resource unknown

modules.name: img_filter_nlm
limitations: Patch-SSD exponential weights, internal synchronous frame storage, replicate border
Default maximum patch radius1/search radius3/frame64x64; serial patch/candidate scan; LUT step 1/16

modules.name: img_filter_temporal_denoise
limitations: Internal synchronous history default; invalid on reset, size change or framing fault
Motion-adaptive blend; optional atomically paired external history; no motion compensation

modules.name: img_filter_exp_weight
limitations: 256 constant Q0.16 exponential weights; rounded exp(-index/16)

modules.name: img_filter_frame_engine
limitations: OP=opening/closing/NLM; synchronous bounded frame RAM; PIXEL_W 1..12
Shared CE; one command frame at a time; no timeout for incomplete upstream frame
